info.title: Metrobi Delivery API
info.description: The Metrobi Delivery API lets businesses create and manage local same-day courier deliveries: create a delivery, get a price/ETA estimate, read and list deliveries, cancel a delivery, and receive real-time status updates via webhooks. Metrobi is a local delivery courier service covering the top US metros.

tags.name: Deliveries
tags.description: Create, read, list, estimate and cancel local courier deliveries.

job_description.description: The description added to the delivery offer to incentivize drivers to take it

address.description: The complete address of the stop, formatted as "Street, City, State ZIP Code, Country"

address2.description: Additional address information such as Apt or Floor

lat.description: Latitude coordinate of the stop. If not provided, we will geocode the address

lng.description: Longitude coordinate of the stop. If not provided, we will geocode the address

instructions.description: Instructions for the driver about how to navigate at this stop

business_name.description: Business name if this is a business location

instructions.description: Instructions for the driver about how to navigate at this stop

business_name.description: Business name if this is a business location

phone.description: Phone number of the receiver. Will be used for delivery status notifications. Non-numeric characters will be automatically ignored. Maximum of 11 numeric characters.

email.description: Email of the receiver. Will be used for delivery status notifications

merge_delivery.description: Should this delivery be merged with a compatible existing delivery (nearby pickup time, compatible pickup stop, not yet started)? The maximum number of stops that can be merged into a single delivery is 50.

return_to_pickup.description: If the driver is required to return to pick-up after completing the delivery.

maximum_number_of_stops.description: The maximum number of stops that can be merged into this delivery

self_managed.description: This delivery will be created as a self-managed delivery. That means the delivery will only be available to your own drivers, and not to drivers from the Metrobi Network

webhook_url.description: url used for you to receive status updates related to the created delivery

parameters.description: The starting date of the range (inclusive). This parameter filters deliveries to include only those with a pickup time on or after the specified date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: The ending date of the range (inclusive). This parameter filters deliveries to include only those with a pickup time on or before the specified date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
